hooks.command: PROTECTED=main; LBF="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.claude/last-branch.txt"; LB=""; if [ -f "$LBF" ]; then LB=$(cat "$LBF" 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ -n "$LB" ] && [ "$LB" != "$PROTECTED" ] && command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then PS=$(gh pr list --head "$LB" --jq '.[0].state' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$PS" = "MERGED" ] || [ "$PS" = "CLOSED" ]; then echo "Branch $LB $PS — deleting…"; git branch -D "$LB" 2>/dev/null || true; git push origin --delete "$LB" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$LBF" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; B=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$B" = "$PROTECTED" ]; then TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); NB="claude/${TS}-$$"; git checkout -b "$NB" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Feature-Branch erstellt: $NB"; echo "$NB" > "$LBF" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

PROTECTED=main; B=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$B" = "$PROTECTED" ] || [ -z "$B" ]; then exit 0; fi

# Push the branch and track it upstream
git push -u origin "$B" 2>&1 | tail -3

# Remember which branch we pushed for next session's cleanup
echo "$B" > "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/last-branch.txt" 2>/dev/null

# Create PR if none exists
if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  EX=$(gh pr list --head "$B" --json number -q 'length' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "${EX:-0}" = "0" ]; then
    gh pr create --fill --base "$PROTECTED" 2>&1 | tail -3
  fi
fi

exit 0
